title: Activity refresh client
responsibility: Refreshes site activity while a browser page is visible and reports missing readings.

inputs.name: activityClient.arrived
inputs.description: Callback receiving parsed activity after a successful request while the client remains active.

inputs.name: activityClient.missed
inputs.description: Callback invoked when an active request fails, including an HTTP or JSON failure.

outputs.name: activityClient
outputs.description: Returns refresh and stop methods. Refresh skips overlapping or stopped requests and uses a no-cache activity request. Polls every 15 seconds while visible and when visibility changes to visible; it does not request immediately on construction. Stop removes the timer/listener and aborts the request.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A non-success HTTP status creates Activity unavailable. internally, but refresh catches it and calls missed while active.
